text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide's big day has arrived!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: This debut race is full of promising prospects who just signed on with new trainers.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: At long last, I get to see the results of my training. It's time to focus and do this!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I promise I won't let you down. Let's take home a win.
